description: Known answers for the OpenSCAD 2021.01 + FreeCAD 1.1.3 sanity check (tools/toolchain.lock.md section 1.1; CM plan section 9.2 table; TV due PDR, shared). cube.scad is a 30 x 20 x 10 mm block minus a 6 mm diameter through hole ($fn = 64) on the vertical axis at (15, 10). Expected values were derived by hand from that geometry before the first run: analytic volume 30 x 20 x 10 - pi x 3^2 x 10 = 5717.257 mm^3 (a 64-sided prism would give 5717.711 mm^3; the two differ by 0.008 %, so the face types, not the volume, show whether FreeCAD made a true cylinder). The STEP step uses the listing of docs/research/enclosure-cnc-and-openscad-pipeline.md step 3 until tools/scad2step.py is committed (CM plan section 8.2 step 3; ADR-008); a run with the listing is developer evidence for freecadcmd, not the known-answer test of tools/scad2step.py.

must_contain: cylinder($fn = 64, $fa = 12, $fs = 2, h = 12, r1 = 3, r2 = 3, center = false);

png_render.inspection: the render is opened and inspected: a rectangular block with one round through hole

step_rejected_by_openscad.expected: non-zero exit and no cube.step written (OpenSCAD 2021.01 cannot export STEP; CM plan section 8.2 step 3)

step_export.measurement: solid count, validity, face types and volume printed by freecadcmd from the exported shape; bounding box measured independently of FreeCAD from the CARTESIAN_POINT entities referenced by VERTEX_POINT entities of cube.step

scad2step.description: Known answers of tools/scad2step.py (TV-015, 2026-09-27). The cube values are the hand-derived step_export values above; the mesh volume is the hand value for the 64-sided hole of cube.scad: 30 x 20 x 10 - 32 sin(2 pi / 64) x 3^2 x 10 = 5717.711 mm^3 (0.008 % above the solid). Seeded-fault outcomes were derived from the ADR-008 restricted dialect and confirmed on the first development run (the FreeCAD behaviour notes say which were observed rather than predicted).
scad2step.freecad_mode_command: CWHT_CSG=<abs csg> CWHT_STL=<abs stl> CWHT_STEP=<abs step> /Applications/FreeCAD.app/Contents/Resources/bin/freecadcmd tools/scad2step.py

smoke_shell.description: Research B2 half-shell (smoke-shell.scad), hand-derived before the run from the source: a rounded rectangle offset(r) offset(-r) square([l, w]) has area l w - (4 - pi) r^2. Outer 110 x 62, r 4, 18 high: 6806.266 mm^2 x 18 = 122512.78; pocket 106 x 58, r 2, from z 2 to the rim (16 high): 6144.566 x 16 = 98313.06; four 2.5 mm floor holes 2 deep: 4 x 9.817 = 39.27; four bosses (6 mm less 2.5 mm, 6 high): 4 x 140.19 = 560.77; solid volume 24721.22 mm^3. Faces: 16 cylindrical (4 outer corners, 4 pocket corners, 4 holes through floor and boss, 4 boss outsides) and 15 planar (4 outer sides, rim, bottom, 4 pocket sides, pocket floor, 4 boss tops), 31 in all. Bounding box x -55..55, y -31..31, z 0..18.

two-roots.scad.marker: SCAD2STEP FAIL C2: expected one top-level object, got 2

two-solids.scad.marker_prefix: SCAD2STEP FAIL C3: invalid or non-solid result (ShapeType Compound

nonuniform-scale.scad.marker: SCAD2STEP FAIL C2: expected one top-level object, got 2
nonuniform-scale.scad.note: observed: FreeCAD 1.1.3 keeps the unscaled cylinder as a second root, so C2 stops the run before C5

scad2step.reproducibility: two conversions of cube.scad give STEP files that differ only in the time-stamp argument of FILE_NAME (CM plan section 9.2 step 1, class A)
